newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Iveco in Chinese gearbox joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Iveco in Chinese gearbox joint venture.

text.p: Iveco, the truck subsidiary of Italian carmaker Fiat, has signed an accord with two Chinese companies to set up a joint venture to market gearboxes.
The accord, signed with Yuejin Motor Group and Hangzhou Advanced Gearbox Corp, is to form Haveco, a joint venture in which each partner will hold 33 percent, a Fiat statement said.

Haveco, with a capital of 37 billion lire, will develop, produce and market gearboxes under Iveco licence for vehicles of the Daily range produced in China by Naveco, Iveco's 50/50 joint venture with Yuejin.
Production in 1997 is forecast at around 18,000 gearboxes, rising to 42,000 in three years.
